description.value: Carbone Pizzeria is a Nanaimo Italian restaurant specializing in traditional and American-style pizzas and pasta, helmed by a chef with over 30 years of fine dining experience. The kitchen sources fresh ingredients from local farmers' markets and uses imported DOP Italian cheeses alongside housemade pastas, clay-oven dishes, and a full antipasto selection. Originally a takeout-only East Coast pizzeria concept, the restaurant expanded to dine-in service in fall 2025.
